description: This is a C# ASP.NET Core controller file that handles HTTP requests related to following and unfollowing user profiles within the application. It defines endpoints for follow and unfollow actions, utilizing MediatR to handle commands.

classes.name: FollowersController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core controller managing follow and unfollow actions for user profiles. It leverages dependency injection of IMediator to dispatch commands.

methods.name: Follow
methods.description: Handles POST requests to follow a user profile identified by username, utilizing MediatR to send an Add.Command.

methods.name: Unfollow
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to unfollow a user profile identified by username, utilizing MediatR to send a Delete.Command.
